attrs.evidence: R5's gate checked that every soft objective had a measurand, a direction and a gaming test, and never looked at its instrument. GPT-5.6 changed SO-WITNESS-RATIO's instrument to INS-DOES-NOT-EXIST, refreshed the receipt digest so the failure would not be masked, and the gate passed; reproduced here. There was a live symptom in the same record: SO-WITNESS-RATIO named INS-MOSAIC-GATE as its instrument, the gate computed no such ratio, and the receipt's after-score pointed at a derived view that did not contain one. Now the gate computes it — 67 of 75 settled claims (at INV-R7.5) carry a resolving witness — and three of the five objectives declare UNMEASURED with a reason, which is the honest state and was previously hidden behind plausible prose.
attrs.gap: SO-WITNESS-RATIO measures WITNESS RESOLUTION, not deciding power. A witness that loads and does not decide the proposition counts as one that does, so the ratio is an upper bound on what its name suggests.

readjudicated.method: redeclared_by_target — a declared design invariant is adopted deliberately, not inherited
readjudicated.note: The source-lane status is recorded in imported_from.source_status as provenance. This field records that the TARGET lane re-established it; the two are separate facts and the gate reads this one.

attrs.statement: A soft objective names instrument ids that resolve, and either references a measurement an instrument actually produced or declares itself UNMEASURED with a reason.
